entries.partTitle: Spatial vs Object Partitioning: Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) Trees

spec.title: System Architecture: Spatial vs Object Partitioning: Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) Trees

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the hierarchical bounding volume hierarchy organizing scene triangles into compact bounding boxes.
Deep inspection calculates minimum and maximum axis-aligned extents enclosing complex geometric clusters.
Comparative analysis contrasts bounding volume hierarchies against uniform grid voxel structures for sparse scenes.
Verification certifies tight bounding box surface areas and complete geometric containment.

entries.partTitle: The Surface Area Heuristic (SAH) & Fast Binned Axis Splitting

spec.title: System Architecture: The Surface Area Heuristic (SAH) & Fast Binned Axis Splitting

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates binned surface area heuristic partitioning dividing spatial bounding boxes into candidate splits.
Deep inspection evaluates traversal costs versus intersection probabilities across spatial partition planes.
Comparative analysis demonstrates how binned evaluation reduces partition time from quadratic to linear complexity.
Verification confirms optimal split axis selection and minimal total tree traversal cost.

entries.partTitle: Linear BVH (LBVH) & 30-Bit Morton Codes (Z-Order Space-Filling Curves)

spec.title: System Architecture: Linear BVH (LBVH) & 30-Bit Morton Codes (Z-Order Space-Filling Curves)

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays linear bounding volume hierarchy construction using thirty-bit Morton space-filling curves.
Deep inspection tracks bit-interleaving coordinate mapping and high-speed radix sorting of primitive centroids.
Comparative analysis benchmarks parallel GPU linear hierarchy sorting against single-threaded CPU recursive splits.
Verification certifies Morton code ordering, hierarchical parent-child pointers, and tree topology.

entries.partTitle: Flat 32-Byte BVH Compaction & Cache-Line Memory Alignment

spec.title: System Architecture: Flat 32-Byte BVH Compaction & Cache-Line Memory Alignment

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the flattened thirty-two-byte node layout engineered for maximum cache line alignment.
Deep inspection tracks axis-aligned minimum and maximum vector packing alongside primitive count offsets.
Comparative analysis contrasts compact linear array storage against fragmented pointer-linked tree nodes.
Verification confirms thirty-two-byte struct alignment, zero memory padding, and peak GPU cache bandwidth.

entries.partTitle: Iterative Register-Stack GPU Traversal & Tree Quality Certification

spec.title: System Architecture: Iterative Register-Stack GPU Traversal & Tree Quality Certification

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates short-stack bounding volume hierarchy traversal utilizing a private register stack.
Deep inspection tracks front-to-back child node ordering based on ray direction signs.

Verification confirms zero stack overflow, optimal ray early-exit, and high-speed traversal throughput.
